Title: QudLink - Second Screen Companion
Description:
[h1]QudLink[/h1]
Turns a second screen into a Qud-styled control panel. Made for dual-screen handhelds like the AYN Thor, with Qud on the top screen and the QudLink app on the bottom one. Also works in a browser on PC.

[h2]Setup: Android handheld (AYN Thor etc.)[/h2]
[b]Recommended: run Qud through DroidDeck.[/b] It's what QudLink is tested with (on an AYN Thor). Other Windows/Steam launchers may work but aren't tested.
[olist]
[*]Subscribe to this mod. In Qud, open [b]Mods[/b] from the main menu, make sure [b]QudLink[/b] is enabled, then restart Qud.
[*]On the handheld, open this link in a browser: [url=https://github.com/UncookedNoodle/QudLink/releases/latest]github.com/UncookedNoodle/QudLink/releases/latest[/url]
[*]Under [b]Assets[/b], tap [b]QudLink.apk[/b] to download it.
[*]Open the downloaded file. If Android blocks it, allow [b]Install unknown apps[/b] for your browser or file manager, then tap [b]Install[/b].
[*]Start Qud and load a save (or start a new game).
[*]Open the [b]QudLink[/b] app on the second screen. It connects on its own within a few seconds.
[/olist]
The app must run on the same device as Qud. It won't connect to Qud running on another device.

[h2]Setup: PC browser (no Android needed)[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Subscribe to this mod, enable it in Qud's [b]Mods[/b] menu and restart Qud.
[*]Load a save.
[*]On the same PC, open [b]http://127.0.0.1:8765/[/b] in any browser. Put the window on a second monitor or beside the game.
[/olist]

[h2]Troubleshooting[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]The app says "Waiting for Caves of Qud":[/b] Qud isn't running, the mod isn't enabled, or you're still on the main menu. Load a save.
[*][b]The browser shows {"hello":"qudlink"}:[/b] the mod is running, but you have an old version. Update the mod (unsubscribe and resubscribe if Steam doesn't) and restart Qud.
[*][b]A button does nothing:[/b] close any menu or popup open in Qud first. Commands wait until you're back on the main game screen.
[/list]

[h2]What it does[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Act[/b] - abilities with live cooldowns and toggles, four pinnable quick slots, common commands.
[*][b]Items[/b] - ground items nearby, equipment and inventory with real tiles. Tap for actions (eat, equip, get...), hold for the description.
[*][b]Near[/b] - creatures in sight with HP. Tap one for details, then go to it or set it as your target. Includes a movement pad.
[*][b]Char[/b] - attributes, mutations, skills, effects and a low-HP alert.
[*][b]Quest[/b] and [b]Log[/b] tabs.
[/list]

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]The mod listens on 127.0.0.1:8765 only, so it can't be reached from your network.
[*]Source: [url=https://github.com/UncookedNoodle/QudLink]github.com/UncookedNoodle/QudLink[/url]
[/list]
